cohort: 8 pregnant women who had received treatment for papillary thyroid cancer before their pregnancy and 45 controls randomly assigned from an institutional perinatal medicine database.
finding: Patients in the cancer group were older, had a higher cesarean section rate, and lower APGAR scores at 1st and 5th minutes compared to controls, but the study concludes that patients with prior papillary thyroid cancer treatment can safely undergo pregnancy.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the cancer group (62.5%) compared to the control group (33.3%).
